meta.source: repo docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md, docs/MOTION_SYSTEM.md, docs/PAGE_BLUEPRINTS.md (iajaykumar.live handoff, checked 2026-09-29)

tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: Main page background. Dark is deep studio ink; light is warm cream daylight.

tokens.name: surface-panel
tokens.usage: Studio panel: cards, menus, the header on scroll.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Raised panel: hover and selected blocks, active filter chip, code blocks.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Headings and body on surface-page, surface-panel and surface-raised. ≥12.3:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Metadata, descriptions, captions on all three surfaces (≥5.5:1 both themes). Also the border of outlined controls, since `border` is too faint for a control edge.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Dividers and restrained card outlines only — decorative (1.2–1.75:1). Never the only edge of a control or a meaningful mark; use text-secondary there.

tokens.name: coral-accent
tokens.usage: Links, focus rings, selected states, cue lines on any surface (dark ≥4.75:1, light ≥5.33:1). Deepens in light theme to stay legible on cream.

tokens.name: coral-fill
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, cue dots, prop highlights. Same coral as the avatar's shirt in both themes. Always carries on-coral text, never white.

tokens.name: on-coral
tokens.usage: Text and icons on coral-fill (6.44:1). Mandatory: coral buttons use dark text.

tokens.name: cool-complement
tokens.usage: Technical secondary accent: mono tags, chapter numbers, tech-stack labels on any surface (≥5.4:1 both themes). Never competes with coral for a primary action.

families.editorial: Fraunces, ui-serif, Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif
families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: hero-title
styles.sample: I build software, then share what the journey taught me.
styles.usage: Home hero H1 only, desktop. Source range 64–72px.

styles.name: hero-title-mobile
styles.sample: I build software, then share what the journey taught me.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: H1 of inner pages (Watch, Speaking, Learn…), desktop. Range 48–56px.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Titles in talk, project, article, learning-path cards, desktop. Range 22–26px.

styles.name: reading-body
styles.sample: Full-stack engineer sharing practical lessons through talks, videos, writing, and hands-on learning.
styles.usage: Long-form and intro paragraphs, desktop, in a 65–72ch column. Range 18–20px.

styles.name: reading-body-mobile
styles.sample: Full-stack engineer sharing practical lessons through talks, videos, writing, and hands-on learning.

styles.name: ui-body
styles.usage: Navigation, buttons, chips, controls, short card descriptions. Same on all widths.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Metadata, dates, captions, footer links. Range 13–14px; 13px acceptable on dense lists.

styles.name: hero-accent
styles.usage: ONE short word inside the hero title, pull quotes, special learning-series titles. Sparingly — never a whole heading. Weight/italic are this system's choice (source names the face only).

styles.name: pull-quote
styles.sample: Build it, then teach what it taught you.
styles.usage: Occasional pull quote in articles or About. Size chosen here; source names the face only.

styles.name: mono-tag
styles.usage: Tech tags, timestamps, durations, chapter numbers (e.g. 01 / 02). Colored cool-complement or text-secondary.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Inline and block code inside articles, on surface-raised.

spacing.note: 8px base unit. The source's main gaps: 8, 16, 24, 32, 48, 64, 96.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, chip padding-y, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Card inner gaps, button padding-x, list item gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card padding, grid gaps between cards, tablet gutter.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Desktop gutter; gap between a heading and its section content.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sub-blocks inside a section.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section spacing on mobile; gap between reading column and right rail.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section spacing on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-button
tokens.usage: Buttons, theme control, menu.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Default card corner (talk, article, learning-path).

tokens.name: radius-card-lg
tokens.usage: Large feature cards: media feature, hero panel. Source range 16–20px.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Topic chips, tag pills, cue dots.

layout.note: Container, rail and breakpoint sizes from the handoff. Breakpoints: refine after visual testing.

tokens.name: container-max
tokens.usage: Max content width on desktop.

tokens.name: reading-column
tokens.usage: Article and long-form column (~65–72ch).

tokens.name: rail-width
tokens.usage: Optional right rail beside the reading column (Writing sidebar); separated by space-8.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Header bar height on desktop.

tokens.name: header-height-mobile
tokens.usage: Header bar height under 768px.

tokens.name: gutter-desktop
tokens.usage: Page side gutter ≥1100px.

tokens.name: gutter-tablet
tokens.usage: Page side gutter 768–1099px.

tokens.name: gutter-mobile
tokens.usage: Page side gutter under 768px.

tokens.name: touch-target
tokens.usage: Minimum height/width of any tappable control.

tokens.name: bp-tablet
tokens.usage: Tablet starts here (min-width).

tokens.name: bp-desktop
tokens.usage: Desktop starts here (min-width).

duration.note: Motion tokens from MOTION_SYSTEM.md; values are the midpoint of each source range. All collapse to 0 under prefers-reduced-motion.

tokens.name: duration-quick
tokens.usage: Buttons, focus details. Source 140–180ms, crisp ease-out.

tokens.name: duration-standard
tokens.usage: Cards, chips, props hover/focus. Source 220–280ms.

tokens.name: duration-theme
tokens.usage: Theme crossfade of surface colors. Source 180–240ms.

tokens.name: duration-spring
tokens.usage: Lesson-card fan, avatar settle. Source 300–420ms.

tokens.name: duration-entrance
tokens.usage: One-time hero opening sequence total. Source 500–700ms.

tokens.name: duration-ambient
tokens.usage: One peripheral hero prop loop only. Source 7–12s.

easing.note: Curves chosen for this system to match the source's feel words.

tokens.name: ease-out-crisp
tokens.usage: Quick: crisp ease-out.

tokens.name: ease-out-gentle
tokens.usage: Standard: gentle ease-out.

tokens.name: ease-spring
tokens.usage: Spring: low overshoot.

tokens.name: ease-decelerate
tokens.usage: Entrance: calm deceleration.
